capabilities: configure regex-to-URL link patterns in the plugin options
open matched text as clickable links in Live Preview
link to internal notes via patterns like [[Journal/$1]]
apply custom CSS classes to matched text
import and export rules as JSON
disambiguation: Does not rewrite matched text into Markdown links in your files; it only renders matches as clickable links and leaves the .md files unchanged.
extras: Ships with three default example rules (Google search, GitHub repos, social handles); links open in the browser, and URLs support String.prototype.replace replacement patterns.
problem: Obsidian only renders explicit wiki or Markdown links, so repeated patterns like social handles or repo shortcuts stay plain text unless you write each link manually.
summary: Regex-based linkifier that turns text matching configurable patterns into clickable links in Live Preview without changing the underlying Markdown files.
